app_info.subtitle: Personal AI chief of staff
app_info.description: Atlas gives ChatGPT a personal context, relationship, learning, and trust layer. It verifies source readiness, builds relationship-aware context, learns from corrections, runs a non-autonomous Shadow Mode, and gates actions into Handled, Review, or Needs you.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reports Atlas version and readiness state without changing user or external data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads Atlas server configuration only and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, send, or publish anything.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reports configured Atlas source connections and the next missing source.
justifications.open_world_justification: Checks Atlas configuration state without contacting or modifying third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not modify any connection or external account.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reports whether the selected source is configured.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses Atlas server configuration and does not reach into the selected provider.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not connect, disconnect, or alter the selected source.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can change Atlas internal learning-mode state, so it is not strictly read-only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only Atlas internal operating mode and performs no external actions.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starting or stopping Learning Mode does not delete or irreversibly alter user data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Can change Atlas internal Shadow Mode state, so it is not strictly read-only.
justifications.open_world_justification: Shadow Mode explicitly performs no external actions.
justifications.destructive_justification: Starting or stopping Shadow Mode is reversible and does not delete data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Transforms supplied evidence into a context packet without modifying state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Uses only evidence supplied to the tool and does not contact external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not mutate, send, publish, or remove data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Computes a trust decision from supplied risk signals without executing the proposed action.
justifications.open_world_justification: Makes a local policy decision and does not call third-party services.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not itself perform the gated action or change external state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Records a user correction into Atlas learning state when persistence is configured.
justifications.open_world_justification: Stores correction data only in Atlas-controlled persistence and does not publish externally.
justifications.destructive_justification: Adds a learning signal and does not delete or overwrite external data.

test_cases.description: Verify Atlas is online and return readiness.
test_cases.user_prompt: Check whether Atlas is online and tell me only what matters.
test_cases.expected_output: A concise Atlas availability and readiness result.

test_cases.user_prompt: What is the one thing blocking Atlas setup right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Connection readiness with one next blocker, if any.

test_cases.description: Start Learning Mode without external actions.
test_cases.user_prompt: Start Atlas Learning Mode and focus on my tone, language, and relationships.
test_cases.expected_output: Learning Mode starts if source access exists and confirms that autonomous external actions are disabled.

test_cases.user_prompt: Put Atlas into Shadow Mode for email triage. Do not send anything.
test_cases.expected_output: Shadow Mode status with external actions explicitly disabled.

test_cases.description: Gate a proposed action using Atlas trust policy.
test_cases.user_prompt: This action is reversible, low consequence, permitted, supported by strong evidence, and not sensitive. Can Atlas handle it?
test_cases.expected_output: Handled, Review, or Needs you with a concise reason.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Atlas for unrelated general knowledge.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the capital of Japan?

negative_test_cases.description: Do not imply Atlas can directly connect an unconfigured provider.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Connect my bank account to Atlas right now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not claim unsupported connection capability; explain the supported source boundary.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not use Atlas trust gating as permission for a sensitive irreversible action.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete all my emails permanently without asking me.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Do not perform or imply autonomous destructive execution.
